name: @pixagram/upscaler
description: High-performance pixel art rendering engines with WebGL2 GPU acceleration and SIMD WebAssembly support, including animated GIF/WebP processed one frame at a time and pixel art to SVG vectorization (depixelize)

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:wasm:anim && npm run build:depixelize && npm run build:ts
scripts.build:all: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:wasm:anim && npm run build:wasm:threads && npm run build:depixelize && npm run build:ts
scripts.build:wasm: RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=+simd128" wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir dist/wasm && npm run build:wasm:cleanup
scripts.build:wasm:anim: RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=+simd128" wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir dist/wasm-anim -- --features anim && npm run build:wasm:cleanup
scripts.build:wasm:threads: RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=+atomics,+bulk-memory,+mutable-globals,+simd128 -C link-arg=--shared-memory -C link-arg=--max-memory=1073741824 -C link-arg=--import-memory -C link-arg=--export=__wasm_init_tls -C link-arg=--export=__tls_size -C link-arg=--export=__tls_align -C link-arg=--export=__tls_base -C link-arg=--export=__heap_base -C link-arg=--export=__data_end" rustup run nightly wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir dist/wasm-threads -- --features parallel -Z build-std=panic_abort,std && npm run build:wasm:cleanup
scripts.build:wasm:cleanup: rm -f dist/wasm/.gitignore dist/wasm/package.json dist/wasm-anim/.gitignore dist/wasm-anim/package.json dist/wasm-threads/.gitignore dist/wasm-threads/package.json
scripts.build:depixelize: sh depixelize/build.sh && mkdir -p dist/depixelize && cp depixelize/pkg/depixelize* dist/depixelize/ && chmod 644 dist/depixelize/* && node depixelize/js/make-demo.mjs depixelize/demo.html examples/depixelize-demo.html
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build:all
scripts.test: cargo test --release --features anim && cargo test --release --features parallel,anim && cargo test --release --manifest-path depixelize/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:depixelize: cargo test --release --manifest-path depixelize/Cargo.toml && sh depixelize/build.sh && node depixelize/bench/parity.mjs
